validation.durationPositive: Enter a duration longer than zero.
validation.urlInvalid: Enter a valid link starting with https://
validation.fileRequired: Choose a video file to upload.
validation.correctRequired: Mark exactly one option as the correct answer.
validation.optionsRequired: Fill in all four options in both languages.

courses.title: Courses
courses.description: Training courses agents complete before taking the quiz. Only published courses are visible to trainees.
courses.dialogDescription: Enter the title and description in both languages.
courses.statusHint: Draft courses are hidden from trainees.
courses.empty: No courses yet. Create the first course to start building the training.

archive.title: Archive this course?
archive.description: “{{name}}” and its videos will be hidden from trainees. Completed progress is kept and you can restore the course later.

videos.title: Course videos
videos.description: Videos inside each course, in the order trainees watch them.
videos.dialogDescription: Upload a file or link to an externally hosted video.
videos.empty: No videos yet. Add the first video to a course.

source.dropTitle: Drag a video here or choose a file
source.dropHint: MP4 or MOV, up to 2 GB. Files are stored privately (prototype: nothing is uploaded).
source.urlHint: Use a private or unlisted link from your video host.

delete.title: Delete this video?
delete.description: “{{name}}” will be removed from the course. Trainee progress for this video is discarded.

questions.title: Quiz question bank
questions.description: Single-answer multiple-choice questions. Each attempt draws from the active questions.
questions.dialogDescription: Write the question and four options in both languages, then mark the one correct answer.
questions.empty: No questions yet. Add questions to build the quiz.
questions.activeHint: Inactive questions are never drawn into new attempts.
questions.shortage: Only {{active}} active questions, but the quiz draws {{count}}. New attempts cannot start until you activate more questions or lower the question count.

config.title: Quiz configuration
config.description: Rules applied to every new quiz attempt.
config.notice: Changes apply only to attempts started after saving. Attempts in progress keep the rules they started with.
config.readOnly: You can view the configuration but your role can't change it.
config.passThresholdHint: Score needed to qualify, e.g. 70% = 7 of 10.
config.timeLimitHint: The attempt is finalized automatically when time runs out.
config.confirmDescription: This creates version {{version}}. Only attempts started after saving use the new rules.

attempts.title: Attempts & results
attempts.description: Quiz attempts by applicants and the agents who qualified.
